text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Since Bamboo Memory wasn't feeling well,
I decided to take her to the nurse's office.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Mmmgh... Times like this call for pure fighting spirit!
I'm gonna go to bed with everything I've got~...!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
...Wait, huh? Why am I outside? What?
Did I wake up without realizing it?

text_block_list.name: Students
text_block_list.text:
"—Ahaha! Doodling with chalk!
Walking outside in fluffy animal slippers!
And floating toy ducks in the fountain!"

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Wha-! What do you think you're doing, running wild like that~?!

text_block_list.name: Shadow Morals Committee Head
text_block_list.text:
Daaahahaha! This academy belongs to us,
the "Shadow Disciplinary Committee" now!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
"What!? The Shadow Disciplinary Committee...!?
Don't tell me you guys were behind everyone's...?"

text_block_list.name: Shadow Morals Committee Head
text_block_list.text:
"Yes, that's the result of the Shadow Disciplinary Committee's work!
No one can resist the thrill of breaking the rules...
Look! Behold the students who have awakened!"

text_block_list.name: Student A
text_block_list.text:
Ahahaha~! I'll pretend I'm going to the bathroom
and play with the cat instead~!

text_block_list.name: Student B
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe, I'll stash chocolate in my ear ornament
and sneak bites during class~!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
W-What in the world are they doing...!
I'll bring them to their senses!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
HEEY! No graffiti allowed!
Keep your appearance tidy! And rubber duckies
are only allowed in the dorm bath, got it?!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
—Haa, haa... Alright! I've straightened
everyone's discipline out! The only one left
violating the rules is you, Shadow Disciplinary Head!

text_block_list.name: Shadow Morals Committee Head
text_block_list.text: Guh... C-curse you!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Seiyaaaa!! Disciplinary Secret Art!
Light-Speed Appearance & Belongings Cheeeck!

text_block_list.name: Shadow Morals Committee Head
text_block_list.text: Gwaaaah!! M-My gaming console! My whoopee cushion! My wickedly cool spiky mask that I wear for no reason at all...!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Hahaa! As long as Bamboo Memory, Disciplinary Committee Chair, is breathing,
I'll neeeever let anyone disrupt the academy's morals!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: ――Huh!? W-Well whaddya know, it was just a dream~.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Still... hehehe. It felt pretty refreshing
and super cool, you know~?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Returning from the nurse's office,
Bamboo Memory seems completely recovered and full of vigor!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Ugh...! N-No matter how much we crack down,
there's just no end to it~...!

text_block_list.name: Shadow Morals Committee Head
text_block_list.text:
Daaahahaha! Looks like you're getting tired!
All right, everyone, get 'em!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Whoa!?

text_block_list.name: Shadow Morals Committee Head
text_block_list.text:
Heh, looking good! Miss Disciplinary Committee Chair...
Or should I say, *former* Disciplinary Committee Chair!?

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Gwaaaah! I've been turned into fluffy red panda slippers! I-I've failed as Disciplinary Committee Chair...!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: "...Gasp?! I-It was a dream...?!"

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
...Gaaah! Even if it was just a dream,
getting beaten by jerks like that...
really leaves a bad taste in my mouth!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A short while later, Bamboo Memory returned from the
infirmary, but... unfortunately, her condition
didn't seem to have improved at all.
